original.statement: The external-secrets release workflow's pinned goreleaser/goreleaser-action was bumped from 6.2.1 to 6.3.0 — a build/CI dependency change with no stated effect on deployed environments.

decision.reason: [ev-be0806689d1e] is only a dependabot "chore(deps)" bump of goreleaser/goreleaser-action, the GitHub Action used to build releases, from 6.2.1 to 6.3.0. That makes it a CI/release-tooling pin. It isn't a dependency on or interaction with another product that a deployed external-secrets environment has, so the product-relationship subject misreads the line. No other subject family fits a build-time action, so no corrected assertion follows from the evidence. The proposed before/after literals are also double-quoted ("\"6.2.1\""), not copied as the text states them.
